scope: Replace the numbered emblems with Glass Tux in every Tahoe and Golden Gate README and in the shared installer Welcome page.

checks.command: Ran four focused native installer navigation and appearance tests for Tahoe and Golden Gate.
Rendered the native Welcome page under isolated Qt offscreen light and dark palettes for both editions. Verified the selected asset and reviewed all four frames.

coverage_limits: Welcome was rendered offscreen against the real Qt wizard. The installer did not apply system changes. The historical gallery provenance is retained.
